verdict.rationale: Fellow documents a public REST Developer API. It uses API-key authentication and cursor-based pagination, and covers recordings and transcripts, action items, uploads, and status polling. Write operations include agenda append, prepend, find/replace and rewrite, plus completing or archiving action items. Webhooks and an llms.txt round it out, so an AI-native user can both read from and drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
